whatThisPluginAdds.text: Site Monitor records HTTP availability, certificate expiry, domain expiry and incidents inside Capell admin, with checks running from your application host. It is a free first-party package with Stable maturity. Check the release catalogue for the verification and availability of the version you plan to install.

surfaceOutcome.text: The package supplies a health dashboard, target and incident resources, scheduled checks and queue jobs. Installation requires current release evidence and host verification; configure the scheduler, queue worker and notification integration before relying on its alerts.

developers.text: Run checks outside the public render path, inspect typed results, connect incident events to your alerting system and retain operator-owned target settings during automatic discovery.

teams.text: Review failing targets and expiry warnings alongside other site operations. A check runs from your application host, not an independent monitoring network; retain independent monitoring for outages that also stop that host.
